skills.name: chembricks-computational-chemistry
skills.description: Use the live Chembricks MCP for computational chemistry and molecular science: resolve or validate molecular structures; calculate molecular properties, descriptors, pKa, logP, solubility, redox, energies, thermochemistry, spectra, conformers, steric descriptors, kinetics, and solvation; search or generate molecules; assess synthesis, stock, stability, purchasability, and narrow safety alerts; investigate metal complexes and polymers; or run multi-objective molecular discovery, screening, and optimization. Apply this skill whenever a user supplies a molecule, name, formula, SMILES, InChI, SELFIES, spectrum, reaction, ligand, candidate library, or chemistry design objective that can benefit from Chembricks evidence.
headings: Keep generic work native to Claude
Select the smallest useful tool chain
Run long or autonomous searches without losing work
